authors: Jurtz VI, Villarroel J, Lund O, Voldby Larsen M, Nielsen M
verified_algorithm: BLASTn against whole-genome bacteriophage references, scoring %ANI to the WHOLE database by merging hits across multiple genomes rather than to a best hit
verification_signal: Primary paper describes identifying phage-origin contigs by comparing query contigs to a database of whole-genome bacteriophage sequences and integrating hits across genomes.

verified_algorithm: MinHash sketching of DNA, with sketches compared or searched by Jaccard index against reference signatures
verification_signal: Primary software paper describes MinHash sketches and Jaccard/containment-style comparison; Table S21 documents benchmark use against a curated viral signature index.
notes: Not virus-specific by design; reference-based here because benchmark classification depends on the supplied viral signature database.

authors: Roux S, Enault F, Hurwitz BL, Sullivan MB
verified_algorithm: Probabilistic scoring over viral protein/HMM hits and genome-context features
verification_signal: Primary paper describes viral-signal mining from microbial genomic data using hallmark genes, viral HMM/protein similarity, enrichment/depletion metrics, and confidence categories.

authors: Guo J, Bolduc B, Zayed AA, Varsani A, Dominguez-Huerta G, Delmont TO, Pratama AA, Gazitua MC, Vik D, Sullivan MB, Roux S
verified_algorithm: Random-forest classifiers across viral groups over one mixed feature vector: hallmark/HMM hit fractions plus gene-organisation and GC statistics (7 of 27 features are HMM-derived)
verification_signal: Primary paper and Table S21 describe multiple expert-guided classifiers, including random forests for dsDNA phage, ssDNA, NCLDV, RNA viruses, and Lavidaviridae.

authors: Kieft K, Zhou Z, Anantharaman K
verified_algorithm: Feed-forward neural network (multi-layer perceptron) over 27 metrics derived from KEGG, Pfam and VOG HMM annotations, weighted by a bespoke v-score
verification_signal: Primary paper describes a hybrid protein-similarity and machine-learning workflow using HMM annotations and an MLP-style classifier.
notes: Feature-based ML over protein-domain annotation metrics, not raw-sequence deep learning.

authors: Ren J, Ahlgren NA, Lu YY, Fuhrman JA, Sun F
verified_algorithm: Logistic regression with lasso regularisation over 8-mer frequencies
verification_signal: Primary paper describes a k-mer frequency machine-learning classifier; methods specify sequence signatures with lasso logistic regression.

authors: Ren J, Song K, Deng C, Ahlgren NA, Fuhrman JA, Li Y, Xie X, Poplin R, Sun F
verified_algorithm: Convolutional neural network over one-hot encoded nucleotide sequence
verification_signal: Primary paper describes an alignment-free, reference-free CNN for viral sequence detection.

authors: Fang Z, Tan J, Wu S, Li M, Xu C, Xie Z, Zhu H
verified_algorithm: Bi-path convolutional neural network over base and codon encodings
verification_signal: Primary paper describes BiPathCNN with separate nucleotide-base and codon paths for phage, plasmid, and chromosome classification.
notes: CNN model with explicit plasmid class.

authors: Wijesekara Y, Wu LY, Beeloo R, Rozwalak P, Hauptfeld E, Doijad SP, Dutilh BE, Kaderali L
verified_algorithm: Dilated convolutional neural network over six-frame amino-acid translations
verification_signal: Primary preprint and Table S21 describe a DCNN-Res model with residual/dilated convolution over translated sequence windows.
notes: Protein-translation CNN; benchmark row uses the published Jaeger model.

authors: Al-Najim A, Hauns S, Tran VD, Backofen R, Alkhnbashi OS
verified_algorithm: HVSeeker-DNA uses bidirectional LSTM over nucleotide sequence; HVSeeker-Protein uses ProteinBERT
verification_signal: Primary paper describes a DNA LSTM model and a protein model; Table S21 documents benchmark execution through the HVSeeker-DNA wrapper.
notes: Placed in this family because the benchmarked DNA branch is recurrent; the full method also includes a ProteinBERT branch.

authors: Auslander N, Gussow AB, Benler S, Wolf YI, Koonin EV
verified_algorithm: LSTM recurrent neural network over nucleotide sequence
verification_signal: Primary paper describes alignment-free bacteriophage identification with an LSTM/RNN model and a phage score threshold.

authors: Peng C, Shang J, Guan J, Wang D, Sun Y
verified_algorithm: DNABERT-2 transformer/foundation model fine-tuned for viral classification
verification_signal: Primary paper describes virus discovery using a genome foundation model; methods use a DNABERT-2 transformer backbone.

authors: Wang J, Sun Z, Wang G, Miao Y
verified_algorithm: Multi-head self-attention over k-mer/codon-token dependencies with graph isomorphism network classification
verification_signal: Primary paper describes k-mer embeddings, self-attention-derived token relationships, and GIN classification for viral sequence detection.
notes: Attention-plus-graph architecture rather than a plain transformer.

authors: Camargo AP, Roux S, Schulz F, Babinski M, Xu Y, Hu B, Chain PSG, Nayfach S, Kyrpides NC
verified_algorithm: IGLOO deep-learning sequence branch plus marker-gene/profile branch integrated at contig level
verification_signal: Primary paper describes combining gene-content/marker evidence with a deep neural-network sequence branch for virus, plasmid, and host classification.
